units.source_text: 不久雨晴月出，源氏太政大臣与萤兵部卿亲王把盏对酌，共话往事。

en.t: Before long the rain cleared and the moon came out, and Genji, the Grand Minister, drank cup for cup with Prince Hotaru of the War Ministry as they spoke of old times.

units.source_text: 此时云月朦胧，柔丽可爱，微雨初晴，凉风习习。

en.t: At that moment the clouds and moon were softly veiled, gentle and lovely; the light rain had just cleared, and a cool breeze stirred.

units.source_text: 梅花之香与熏香相交混，合成一种不可名状的气味，充满于殿宇各处，令人心情异常幽雅。

en.t: The scent of plum blossoms mingled with incense, forming an indescribable fragrance that filled every part of the palace and made the heart feel unusually refined.

units.source_text: 事务所里的人正在准备明日的管弦合奏，将各种弦乐器加以装饰。

en.t: The people in the offices were preparing for the next day's concert of winds and strings, decorating all kinds of stringed instruments.

units.source_text: 又有许多殿上人进来，演习吹笛，音节甚美。

en.t: Many courtiers also came in to practice playing the flute, and the notes were exceedingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 内大臣家的两位公子头中将柏木与弁少将红梅，前来参见之后，即将退出，

en.t: The Minister of the Interior's two sons, Kashiwagi the Captain and Kobai the Lesser Captain of the Ben, came to pay their respects and were about to withdraw,

units.source_text: 源氏却将两人留住，命人取过各种弦乐器来，

en.t: but Genji kept the two of them there and ordered various stringed instruments to be brought in,

units.source_text: 将琵琶交与萤兵部卿亲王，筝琴由源氏自己弹奏，和琴赐与柏木。

en.t: he handed the biwa to Prince Hotaru of the War Ministry, played the koto himself, and gave the wagon to Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 弦乐合奏，音节华丽，异常悦耳。

en.t: The string ensemble sounded splendid and was extraordinarily pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 夕雾吹奏横笛，曲调与春季时令相合，清音响彻云霄。

en.t: Yugiri played the transverse flute; the melody suited the spring season, and its clear tones rang up into the clouds.

units.source_text: 红梅按拍，唱催马乐《梅枝》，歌声异常美妙。

en.t: Kobai kept the beat and sang the saibara song Plum Branch, his voice exceptionally beautiful.

units.source_text: 此人童年之时，曾在掩韵游戏之后即席吟唱催马乐《高砂》。

en.t: When he was a child, after a rhyme-concealing game, he had once sung the saibara song Takasago on the spot.

units.source_text: 今唱《梅枝》，萤兵部卿亲王与源氏太政大臣都来助唱。

en.t: Now, as he sang Plum Branch, Prince Hotaru of the War Ministry and Genji, the Grand Minister, both joined in to support him.

units.source_text: 此次虽非正式盛会，却是极有风趣的夜游。

en.t: Although this was not a formal grand gathering, it was a night amusement of remarkable charm.
